class: Signal file consumed before its writer finishes
symptom: The Continue waiter returned an empty decision in PR CI.
root_cause: File existence became true before write_text wrote the answer, so the waiter read and deleted an empty file.
why_tests_missed: The existing threaded test depended on scheduling and usually passed locally.
fix: Poll for nonempty content, preserve a pending empty file, and use the same observed content as the decision.
prevention: Exercise the intermediate empty-file state deterministically.
